feedback: Pre-race review of the candidate that reverts geometry to the iteration 0 layout and changes three controller values (kp 2.5 to 3.0, kd 0.2 to 0.4, base_speed 1.2 to 1.0). Iteration 0 is still the best raced design (score 84.6). Iteration 1 showed that widening the sensors to x = -0.08 to +0.08 with kp 5.0 cut oval progress from 0.35 to 0.19 and raised oval line-loss events from 1.15 to 2.4. That is evidence against the widened array and against kp 5.0. This candidate returns to the 0.02-spacing array, so it is valid and does not repeat that change. The candidate is valid: all sensor positions are within limits, the weights are unchanged at (-2, -1, 0, 1, 2), and kp, kd, base_speed and line_loss are in range. The rationale's claim that max_error sits at the 0.06 m off-track limit on every track in iteration 1 and iteration 0 is consistent with the outcome table, so the fix has to reduce bend error rather than widen sensing. The changes are small and separable, so the next race can be read clearly. Do not state how this candidate will perform. Once the race reports, use the results as follows. If line_loss_events fall to about 1.0 or below and progress on the oval is at least 0.35, keep kp near 3.0 and kd at 0.4. If progress falls while line losses do not improve, base_speed was not the cause, so restore kp to 2.5 and keep the other values. If max_error still reaches 0.06 on the s-bend at base_speed 1.0, the error is controller lag: try ki of about 0.05 to 0.1 or a higher kd of about 0.6, not a wider array. If the run is stable with spare time, raise base_speed in steps of 0.2 to recover progress.
requested_changes: After the race, if line_loss_events fall to about 1.0 or below and oval progress holds at 0.35 or more, keep geometry at the iteration 0 layout with kp 3.0, kd 0.4 and base_speed 1.0. This is the best trade so far, since iteration 0 (kp 2.5, kd 0.2, base_speed 1.2) scored 84.6.

If progress falls with no drop in line_loss_events, speed was not the cause. Restore controller.kp to 2.5 and keep kd at 0.4 and base_speed at 1.0, since iteration 0 showed kp 2.5 as the best gain so far.

If max_error stays at about 0.06 on the s-bend (as in iteration 0 and iteration 1, both near the off-track limit), try controller.ki of 0.05 to 0.1 or raise controller.kd to about 0.6. Do not widen the sensor array again, because iteration 1 showed that widening did not reduce max_error.
